critical_code_review_comments: DiscountIn.cleaned() only strips title/description/image_url/terms — if you later add more string fields to DiscountIn, remember to add them to the tuple in server.py:200.

/merchants/me/profile trims all string fields via isinstance check — good. But there is no min-length validation: a merchant can now save shop_name='' (empty string) via PUT /merchants/me/profile. Consider rejecting empty strings after strip.

/auth/register still falls back to 'Negozio'/'Centro Storico'/'Ristorante' defaults if merchant leaves fields blank (server.py:284-286). This means a merchant registering with only email+name gets shop_name='<their name>' and category='Ristorante' — that is the source of the 'Ristorante' shop_name showing on public /discounts cards (data-quality issue observed in frontend). Consider requiring shop_name+zone+category for role='merchant' at register time.
server.py is now ~1500 lines (carry-over from iter4) — split into routers is overdue.
No index on discounts.created_at, but list_discounts sorts client-side after .to_list(500) — fine for now but plan an index if catalog grows.

rca of the issue: Original bug: first 3 shops on /discounts were incomprehensible because (a) 10 leftover TEST_/testing-agent users from previous iterations were still in DB with generic/whitespace-polluted names, and (b) DiscountIn had no strip() on save so merchants could submit '  Pizza  ' and it would render with visible trailing spaces in the card. Fix applied by main agent: one-off Mongo migration deleted TEST leftovers + stripped whitespace on existing records; DiscountIn.cleaned() now strips on write, POST /merchants/me/discount returns 422 if title/description empty after strip, PUT /merchants/me/profile trims all string fields, /auth/register trims name/shop_name/zone/category. Verified end-to-end: 9 clean cards on /discounts, all new merchant submissions with whitespace are stored stripped, empty inputs are rejected with 422.
